mission.name: Barrot V3 Autonomous Build Acquisition
mission.objective: Enable Barrot to acquire, generate, validate, drop, execute, and evidence its own next development bundles while preserving repository safety, provenance, verification, rollback, and human governance.
mission.continuation_target: Continue the current Barrot V3 build from the live repository state. Do not restart historical work. Preserve existing dirty work and use live repository evidence as authoritative.
immediate_priority: Connect bundle generation to the existing self-drop bridge.
Preserve provenance for every generated bundle.
Allow validated continuation work to become the next bundle.
Prepare the system for autonomous continuation of the V3 build.
